main_body: sci-fi metal floor and wall panel terrain tiles
top_band: blue-grey metal panel surface across full 16x16 tiles (rows 0-47)
evidence: This is a 4x3 grid of 16x16 sci-fi metal terrain/floor/panel tiles with beveled edges, rivets, recessed hatches, and glowing cyan accents, appropriate for the 'terrain' kind.

style.evidence: The sci-fi panels use 6 shades of slate blue-grey plus 4 cyan steps for the indicator light. Bevels, rivets, seams, and recessed hatches break up the 16x16 tiles so there are no large flat fills, and seam lines use dark blue-grey material tones rather than pure black. While slightly cleaner than cobblestone due to the manufactured metal material, the craft and value steps are solid.
